title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gdb security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-13732) in the GNU Debugger (GDB) affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support. The flaw is an out-of-bounds write in the STABS parser function read_member_functions() triggered by crafted ELF files. Red Hat has issued an important security advisory and released updated packages to address this issue.
